Loads an sBPF ELF, applies relocations, and writes the rodata segment.

# Purpose
This file contains a small command-line tool that loads an sBPF program from an ELF binary, checks the file type, and parses loader metadata with `fd_sbpf_elf_peek`. It allocates memory for the program, rodata, and syscall table, then calls `fd_sbpf_program_load` to load and relocate the program with a fixed set of syscall IDs stored in `_syscalls`. If `--fixup-calls` is set, it walks the loaded text section and rewrites hashed call targets back into relative call offsets, and if `--rodata-out` is set, it writes the final rodata segment to a file. The program ends by releasing all allocated objects and reporting success or failure through the `FD_LOG_*` and `FD_TEST` checks.
